encode_rna_human.unit: TPM per gene, replicates averaged (log1p stored); RSEM TPM, or STAR gene counts converted with GENCODE exon-union lengths where only those exist (annotation None)

encode_rna_mouse.unit: TPM per gene, replicates averaged (log1p stored); RSEM TPM, or STAR gene counts converted with GENCODE exon-union lengths where only those exist (annotation None)

methylation_wgbs.unit: promoter methylation (TSS +/- 1 kb, atlas blocks), beta x 250 as uint8, 255 = no coverage

not_fetched.contact_maps: 77 Hi-C / Micro-C maps of 10-100+ GB each; the compact form the model needs (1-Mb-window contacts at 2 kb) means reading most of each file. Not pulled.
not_fetched.methylation_snm3c: single-nucleus ALLC files (terabytes on Hugging Face). Not pulled; the bulk WGBS atlas is.
not_fetched.single_cell_corpus: raw count matrices of the 36 studies (terabytes). Their cell-type summaries are covered by the CELLxGENE aggregates wherever the study is on CELLxGENE; ENCODE/GEO-only studies are not.
not_fetched.expression_encoder_cells: 107 million individual cells (terabytes). Summarised as CELLxGENE per-cell-type aggregates instead.
not_fetched.bulk_rna_recount3: recount3 coverage (terabytes); GTEx and ENCODE gene-level expression pulled instead.
not_fetched.procap: PRO-cap tracks: source list is in AlphaGenome 1's supplement, not this paper. Not pulled.
not_fetched.tenk10k: TenK10K single-cell eQTL summary statistics: no public download found (2026-11-17).
not_fetched.parkinsons: Sigalova et al. 2026 Parkinson's multiome: cohort data, access not public / not located.
not_fetched.covid_vaccine: Zhang et al. 2023 vaccine atlas: GEO accession not confirmed (candidates GSE202262, PRJNA985376/7). Not pulled.
not_fetched.astrocyte_crispri: Green et al. 2026 astrocyte CRISPRi: data location not found. Not pulled.
not_fetched.cellxgene_heldout: evaluation split of CELLxGENE; the data are inside the CELLxGENE aggregates.
not_fetched.imputation_heldout: ENCODE tracks; inside the ENCODE pulls.
not_fetched.ag1_qtl_benchmarks: AlphaGenome 1 benchmark sets; defined in AlphaGenome 1's supplement. Not pulled.
not_fetched.hudep2_bcl11a: single-locus case study: 3.8 GB ATAC bigWigs + 12.9 GB Capture-Pore-C pairs. Not pulled.
not_fetched.ag2_predictions: AlphaGenome 2's own predictions: the download page needs a Google account sign-in. Not pulled from here.
not_fetched.gwas_panel_gnomad: gnomAD v4.1 common variants: sites files are hundreds of GB. Not pulled; Open Targets credible sets are.
